maya: Quick morning run comparing weight-only INT8 on aurora-13b across two libs: bitsandbytes (bnb) vs llm.int8. Posting numbers + notes.
maya: Setup: fp16 baseline then two weight-only int8 variants. Prompts from our 'hf-qa-mix-1k' dev split, fixed seed, batch=1, max_new_tokens=128, kv cache on. HW: A100-40GB and a consumer RTX3090 for memory checks.
maya: commands used:
```
# fp16 baseline
python launch_eval.py --model /mnt/models/aurora-13b --dtype fp16 --batch 1 --warmup 16
# bitsandbytes weight-only int8
python launch_eval.py --model /mnt/models/aurora-13b --quantize bnb --dtype int8 --batch 1 --warmup 16
# llm.int8 weight-only (per-channel)
python launch_eval.py --model /mnt/models/aurora-13b --quantize llmint8 --dtype int8 --batch 1 --warmup 16
```
maya: Results (avg over 4 runs each) on A100:
- fp16 baseline: p50=88ms p95=185ms tokens/s=410, GPU mem peak=30.8GB, QA EM=79.1%
- bnb (nf4 weight-only): p50=105ms p95=225ms tokens/s=345, GPU mem peak=19.6GB, QA EM=76.8% (delta -2.3)
- llm.int8 (per-channel, selective-fp16): p50=98ms p95=210ms tokens/s=370, GPU mem peak=15.9GB, QA EM=78.3% (delta -0.8)
maya: On RTX3090 (single run, memory-focused):
- bnb mem peak=17.3GB (OOM on some long prompts), llm.int8 mem peak=13.5GB (fits all prompts). fp16 OOM on longest prompts.
maya: Observations: llm.int8 consistently uses less memory and preserves more EM. bnb shows higher outlier count and a few truncation artifacts on very long context.
emma: which quant params for bnb? default nf4 or q4_0? could change tradeoffs.
maya: used default nf4 for bnb. will run q4_0 as ablation. Also toggled --no-prefetch in bnb to rule out casting spikes.
raj: can you paste per-layer outlier log? curious which layers are folded in llm.int8.
maya: snippet from logs:
```
[llmint8] outliers=9, layers_folded=[22,23,24], fallback_count=3
[bnb] outliers=34, layers_folded=[]
```
maya: llm.int8 folded top-3 attention-dense layers to fp16 which likely helps QA retention.
olivia: nice. can you also check generation repeat rate / n-gram overlaps? sometimes quantized runs repeat more.
maya: ran a quick ngram-check: bnb has +1.7% 3-gram repeat vs fp16, llm.int8 +0.6%.
eval-bot: perf-summary: model=aurora-13b runs=4 hardware=A100 metrics=[p50:88/105/98 ms, p95:185/225/210 ms, tokens/s:410/345/370, memGB:30.8/19.6/15.9] acc=[79.1/76.8/78.3]
raj: good. please upload raw outputs and add per-prompt EM so we can see which question types lose the most.
maya: uploading to s3://redwood-evals/aurora13b/int8-backends/1780123456. Outputs + per-prompt csv done.
emma: next steps: run bnb with q4_0, bnb with --act-order, and AWQ/GPTQ conversions if we can get them for aurora-13b. Also schedule batch=4 throughput runs for Dedicated sizing.
dan: ops note: if llm.int8 keeps mem wins, we should consider it as default for Dedicated small-GPU profiles. but wait for AWQ/GPTQ numbers before recommending.
